code:
acks=0     no wait — fastest, can silently lose events
acks=1     waits for the leader broker only
acks=all   waits for leader + in-sync replicas — durable, slower
caption: Not "always use all" — telemetry vs. an order have different costs.

code:
Key-based:    same key -> same partition, in order
Round-robin:  no key -> spread evenly across partitions

Wrong choice: wasted partitions, or silently broken ordering
caption: Key-based buys ordering; round-robin buys even load spread.

code:
linger.ms=0   send immediately — lowest latency, more requests
linger.ms=5   wait up to 5ms, batch together — higher throughput

batch.size    max bytes accumulated before a forced send
caption: A real latency-vs-throughput trade-off, not a free win.
